title: Integrate BCH + LDPC + interleaver + QAM into unified FEC chain
description:
## Goal

Wire the existing DVB-T2 BICM component pieces (BCH+LDPC concat codec
`a18956a4`, column-row bit interleaver `87a2402f`, and the existing
Gray-QAM mapper/demapper) into a documented, tested end-to-end chain
composition.

This story is **glue-only**: it does NOT introduce a new
`DvbT2BicmChain` top-level type. The "chain" is the documented call
sequence; the campaign runner (`152388f4`) consumes that sequence
directly via the existing pieces.

```
BBFRAME → BCH encode → LDPC encode → bit interleave → QAM map
                                                            ↓
                                                          AWGN
                                                            ↓
        BCH decode ← LDPC decode ← bit deinterleave ← QAM demap
```

## Context

Components present or in-flight (cited as their JIT short IDs):

- BCH outer encoder/decoder — done, all 12 DVB-T2 configs
  (`crates/gf2-coding/src/bch/dvb_t2/`).
- LDPC inner encoder/decoder — done, all 12 DVB-T2 parity tables in
  Rust consts (`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/`).
- BCH+LDPC concatenation codec — task `a18956a4` (provides the
  concrete `DvbT2Concat`-style type).
- DVB-T2 column-row bit interleaver — task `87a2402f` (provides
  `DvbT2BitInterleaver`).
- Gray-QAM mapper / soft demapper — done (`d4851c3d` epic closed),
  located in `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/`.

The 3 in-scope (rate × modulation) configurations are
Normal × {1/2, 2/3, 3/4} × {16-QAM, 64-QAM}.

## Deliverables

1. Integration test module verifying the end-to-end
   forward + inverse composition of the BCH+LDPC concat codec, the
   bit interleaver, and the existing Gray-QAM mapper/demapper for
   all 3 × 2 in-scope configurations. No new top-level
   `DvbT2BicmChain` type; the chain is the documented call sequence.
2. A canonical composition example at
   `crates/gf2-coding/examples/dvb_t2_bicm_chain.rs` demonstrating
   the forward and inverse call sequence with rustdoc-style
   commentary. Builds under
   `cargo build --workspace --release --examples`.
3. Documentation: rustdoc on `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2`
   describing the canonical chain composition (call order, types,
   payload flow). CLAUDE.md `gf2-coding` module map updated.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All 3 × 2 in-scope configurations round-trip random
  payloads bit-exact at very high SNR (effectively noiseless) when
  composed via the documented call sequence (integration test).
- [hard] The chain is wired end-to-end through the
  bit-interleaver-aware path; the TP07a vector validation
  (`4cdaf1c5`) is satisfied via this composition.
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; satisfies `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Example builds and runs under
  `cargo run --release --example dvb_t2_bicm_chain`.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md gf2-coding module map updated.

## Non-goals

- No new public top-level type. The chain is composition over the
  three existing pieces.
- No AWGN simulation harness changes — that is in NEW-INFRA
  (`fd73e8a8`).
- No campaign binary, CSV, or plotting — that is in NEW-2
  (`152388f4`).
- No production campaign runs — that is in `e4849f07`.
- No fading or non-AWGN channels.
- 9 out-of-scope LDPC configurations may panic with
  `unimplemented!` or return `Err`.
